question: Can their indexing-based method be applied to create other QA datasets in other domains, and not just Wikipedia?
title: Analysis of Wikipedia-based Corpora for Question Answering
answer_rationale: The paper presents an indexing-based method for creating a silver-standard dataset for answer retrieval using the entire Wikipedia, and it suggests this method can be applied to other domains by mapping answer contexts to the same version of Wikipedia, as demonstrated by the use of Lucene indexing and cosine similarity for retrieving relevant paragraphs across different corpora.
